description: Na₂Mg₃Cl₈ is beta indium sulfide-derived structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. Na is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form distorted NaCl₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with six equivalent MgCl₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent MgCl₆ octahedra, and edges with three equivalent NaCl₆ pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 50°. There are three shorter (2.78 Å) and three longer (2.84 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. Mg is bonded to six Cl atoms to form MgCl₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaCl₆ pentagonal pyramids, edges with four equivalent MgCl₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaCl₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are four shorter (2.50 Å) and two longer (2.53 Å) Mg-Cl bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Mg atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClNa₂Mg₂ trigonal pyramids. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three equivalent Mg atoms.
